detailed_descriptions.en: You are the spirit of an ancient dark sorcerer, banished from the mortal realm centuries ago. But now, these fools have dared to summon you back. Assemble your army of death - the time for vengeance has come! SUMMON THE UNDEAD You have been granted power over the dead, for you are the Lord of the Undead . Create various types of minions: from simple skeletons and zombies to wraiths and plague creatures. Craft weapons and armor for them, level them up, and strengthen your army. Your minions can carry out various orders. They can be tasked with gathering resources or defending your base. Or, you can command them to raze a human village to the ground… RECLAIM YOUR POWER Restore your former strength by consuming mortal souls, crafting equipment from found resources, and learning new talents. Choose your path of progression: dark magic, archery, heavy weapons and armor - or combine them all. Customize your character to fit your playstyle and use a rich set of abilities to leave those pathetic mortals no chance at all. BUILD YOUR DARK BASE A flexible building system and a variety of structures and workbenches are at your disposal. But before you build - desecrate the land! Place Pylons of Darkness in strategic locations and reshape the landscape to suit a dark lord. On desecrated ground, you and your minions grow stronger, buildings can regenerate, and resources produce dark essence. ANNIHILATE THE MORTALS Wipe out entire human settlements, establish your outposts there, and claim their resources. Create an invincible army of death and lead it through the mortal lands, carry out your dark deeds, and let the whole world fall.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
You are the spirit of an ancient dark sorcerer, banished from the mortal realm centuries ago. But now, these fools have dared to summon you back. Assemble your army of death - the time for vengeance has come!

SUMMON THE UNDEAD

You have been granted power over the dead, for you are the Lord of the Undead.

Create various types of minions: from simple skeletons and zombies to wraiths and plague creatures.

Craft weapons and armor for them, level them up, and strengthen your army.

Your minions can carry out various orders. They can be tasked with gathering resources or defending your base. Or, you can command them to raze a human village to the ground…

RECLAIM YOUR POWER

Restore your former strength by consuming mortal souls, crafting equipment from found resources, and learning new talents.

Choose your path of progression: dark magic, archery, heavy weapons and armor - or combine them all.

Customize your character to fit your playstyle and use a rich set of abilities to leave those pathetic mortals no chance at all.

BUILD YOUR DARK BASE

A flexible building system and a variety of structures and workbenches are at your disposal.

But before you build - desecrate the land!

Place Pylons of Darkness in strategic locations and reshape the landscape to suit a dark lord.

On desecrated ground, you and your minions grow stronger, buildings can regenerate, and resources produce dark essence.

ANNIHILATE THE MORTALS

Wipe out entire human settlements, establish your outposts there, and claim their resources.

Create an invincible army of death and lead it through the mortal lands, carry out your dark deeds, and let the whole world fall.
